# Cncf Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes Reviewer

Review Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes takes care of the Installation, Monitoring, and Maintenance of the Kubernetes control plane. Leaseweb also manages the underlying equipment and network infrastructure, making Kubernetes easy and efficient.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
